subsection.name: Automation Support for Accuracy and Currency
description: maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the baseline configuration of the system using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Retention of Previous Configurations
description: retain organization defined number of previous verisons of baseline configurations of the system to support rollback

subsection.name: Development and Test Environments
description: maintain a baseline configuration for system development and test environments that is managed separately from the operational baseline configuration

subsection.name: Configure Systems and Components for High Risk Areas
description: issue organization defined systems or system components with organization defined configurations to individuals traveling to locations that the organization deems to be of significant risk
Apply the following controls to the systems or components when the individuals return from travel: organization defined controls

subsection.name: Automated Documentation, Notification, and Prohbition of Changes
description: use orgnaization defined automated mechanisms to
document proposed changes to the system
notify orgnaization defined approval authorities of proposed changes to the system and request change approval
highlight proposed changes to the system that have not been approved or disapproved within orgnaization defined time period
prohibit changes to the system until designated approvals are received
document all changes to the systems
notify orgnaization defined personnel when approved changes to the system are completed

subsection.name: Testing, Validation, and Documentation of Changes
description: test, validate, and document chagnes to the system before finalizing the implementation of changes

subsection.name: Security and Privacy Representatives
description: require organization defined security and privacy representatives to be members of the organization defined configuration change control elements

subsection.name: Automated Security Response
description: implement the following security responses automatically if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner: organization defined security responses

subsection.name: Cryptography Management
description: ensure that cryptographic mechanisms used to provide the following controls are under configuration management: organization defined controls

subsection.name: Review System Changes
description: review chagnes to the system orgnaization defined frequency or when orgnaization defined circumstances to determine whether unauthorized changes have occured

subsection.name: Prevent or Restrict Configuration Changes
description: prevent or restrict changes to the configuration of the system under the following circumstances: organization defined circumstances

subsection.name: Separate test Environments
description: analyze changes to the system in a separate test environment before implementation in an operational environment, looking for security and privacy impats due to flaws, weakness, incompatibility, or intentional malice

subsection.name: Verification of Controls
description: after system changes, verify that the impacted controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended, and producing the desired outcome with regard to meeting the security and privacy requirements for the system

subsection.name: Automated Access Enforcement and Audit Records
description: enforce access restrictions using orgnaization defined automated mechanisms
automatically generate audit records of the enforcement actions

subsection.name: Dual Authorization
description: enforce dual authorization for implementing changes to organization defined system components and system level information

subsection.name: Privilege Limitation for Production and Operation
description: limit privileges to change system components and system related information within a production or operational environment
review and reevaluate privileges organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Privilege Limitation for Production and Operation
description: limit privileges to change system components and system related information within a production or operational environemnt
review and reevaluate priviledges organizaiton defined frequency

subsection.name: Limit Library Privileges
description: limit priviledges to change software resident within software libraries

subsection.name: Automated Management, Application, and Verification
description: manage, apply, and verify configuration settings for organizaiton defined system components using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Respond to Unauthorized Changes
description: take the following actions in response to unauthorized changes to organization defined configuration settings: organization defined actions

subsection.name: Periodic Review
description: review the system organization defined frequency to identifiy unnecessary and/or nonsecure functions, ports, protocols, software, and service
disable and remove orgnaization defined functions, port, protocols, software, and services within the system deemed to be unnecessary and/or nonsecure

subsection.name: Prevent Program Execution
description: prevent program execution in accordance with organization defined policies, rules of behavior, and/or access agreements regarding software program usage and restrictions, rules authorizing the terms and conditions of software program usage

subsection.name: Registration Compliance
description: ensure compliance with organization defined registration requirements for functions, ports, protocols, and services

subsection.name: Unauthorized Software - Deny by Execution
description: identify organization defined software programs not authorized to execute on the system
employ an allow all, deny by exception policy to prohibit the execution of unauthorized software programs on the system
review and update the list of unauthorized software programs at organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Autohrized Software - Allow by Exception
description: identify organization defined software programs authorized to execute on the system
employ a deny all, permit by execution policy to allow the execution of authorized software programs on the system
reveiw and update the list of authorized software programs at organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Confined Environments with Limited Privileges
description: require that the following user installed software execute in a configed physical or virtual machine environment with limited privileges: organization defined  user installed software

subsection.name: Code Execution in Protected Environments
description: allow execution of binary or machine executable code only in confined physical or virtual environments and with explicit approval of organization defined personnel or roles when such code it
obtained from sources with limited or no warranty
without the provision of source code

subsection.name: Binary or Machine Executable Code
description: prohibit the use of binary or machine executable code from sources with limited or no warranty or without the provision of source code
allow exceptions only for compelling mission or operational requirements and with the approval of the authorizing official

subsection.name: Prohibiting the Use of Unauthorized Hardware
description: idenitfy organization defined hardware components authorized for system use
prohibit the use or connection of unauthorized hardware components
review and update the list of authorized hardware components at organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Updates During Installation and Removal
description: update the inventory of system components as part of component installations, removals, and system updates

subsection.name: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection
description: maintain the currency, completeness, accuracy, and availability of the inventory of system components using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Automated Unauthorized Component Detection
description: detect the preseence of unauthorized hardware, software, and firmware components within the system using organization defined automated mechanisms at organization defined frequency
take the following actions when unauthorized components are detected: disable network access by such components, isolate the components, notify organization defined personnel or roles

subsection.name: Accountability Infomration
description: include in the system component inventory information, a mean for idenitfying by name, poisiton, role, individuals responsible and accountbale for administering those components

subsection.name: Assessed Configurations and Approved Deviations
description: include assessed component configurations and any approved deviations to current deployed configurations in the system component inventory

subsection.name: Centralized Repository
description: provide a centralized repository for the inventory of system components

subsection.name: Automated Location Tracking
description: support the track of system components by geographic location using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Assignment of Components to Systems
description: assign system components to a system
receive an acknowledgement from organization defined personnel or roles of this assignment

subsection.name: Assignment of Responsibility
descritpion: assign responsibility for developing the configuration management process to organizational personnel that are not directly involved in system development

subsection.name: Open Source Software
description: establish the following restrictions on the sue of open source software: organization defined restrictions

subsection.name: Software Installation with Privileged Status
description: allow user installation of software only with explicit privileged status

subsection.name: Automated Enforcement and Monitoring
description: enforce and monitor compliance with software installation policies using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Automated Tools to Support Infomration Location
description: use automated tools to identify organization defined information by information type on organization defined system components to ensure controls are in place to protect organizational information and individual policy
